rules.quote: Treat the entire folder as read-only and user-owned.
rules.rule: Treat the case-studies/aeneas/ folder as read-only and user-owned.

rules.quote: Do not edit, add, delete, rename, format, generate files in, stage, or commit
rules.rule: Do not edit, add, delete, rename, format, generate files in, stage, or commit files in the case-studies/aeneas/ folder.

rules.quote: Reading it for context is allowed only when needed for a task outside the
rules.rule: Read files in the case-studies/aeneas/ folder for context only when needed for a task outside that folder.

rules.quote: An explicit later instruction naming work inside `case-studies/aeneas/` is
rules.rule: Only override the case-studies/aeneas/ read-only restriction for a task when an explicit later instruction names work inside that folder.

rules.quote: References to the folder from documentation elsewhere may be updated when
rules.rule: Update references to the case-studies/aeneas/ folder in documentation elsewhere when requested.

rules.quote: Work the DL slices in order
rules.rule: Work the DL slices of dalek-lite in the order given in the DL series in case-studies/dalek-lite/PLAN.md.

rules.quote: set up the agenda of all missing
rules.rule: Before implementing any features, set up an agenda of all missing Vermilion features.

rules.quote: implement them **one by one**
rules.rule: Implement the missing Vermilion features one at a time, not in parallel.

rules.quote: update logs, documentation, differential tests, examples
rules.rule: After each slice, update the logs, documentation, differential tests, and examples.

rules.quote: flip `--expect-unsupported` off as the fragment catches up
rules.rule: As the fragment catches up, flip the dalek-lite probes' `--expect-unsupported` flag off.

rules.quote: the READMEs
rules.rule: After each slice, update the READMEs.

rules.quote: then commit and push, and go to the next one.
rules.rule: After each slice is complete and its updates are made, commit and push, then proceed to the next slice.

rules.quote: Never re-pin dalek-lite implicitly
rules.rule: Never change the pinned dalek-lite version implicitly; re-pin only when explicitly instructed.

rules.quote: read-only per [[aeneas-folder-read-only]]
rules.rule: Treat case-studies/aeneas/ as read-only and do not modify it.

rules.quote: Effort is reported against CryptoProver's published numbers.
rules.rule: When reporting effort for the dalek-lite work, compare it against CryptoProver's published numbers.

rules.quote: **How to apply:** Staged: (1) formal semantics of the neutral textual IR
rules.rule: When working on this future milestone, proceed in stages: first give formal semantics to the neutral textual IR.

rules.quote:
build it on **Loom** (verse-lab) or a
similar Lean program-logic framework, not from scratch.
rules.rule: Build the foundational VC generator on Loom (or a similar Lean program-logic framework) rather than implementing the framework from scratch.

rules.quote: so require Loom directly when this work starts.
rules.rule: When this work starts, add Loom as a direct requirement rather than relying on it transitively.

rules.quote:
Prefer extending the Lean lemma library (prelude facts, `@[simp]`/
  `@[grind]` tags — the M4 "Lean way") over tactic-ladder tuning
rules.rule: For proof fns, prefer extending the Lean lemma library (prelude facts, @[simp]/@[grind] tags) over tuning the tactic ladder.

rules.quote:
accept
  residual `proof fn` mismatches in the differential corpus when a short
  interactive twin proof discharges them
rules.rule: Accept residual proof fn mismatches in the differential corpus when a short interactive twin proof discharges them.

rules.quote:
Keep ladder failures graceful: per-rung heartbeat budgets
  (`Vermilion/Obligations.lean`, `vrml_ladder`) exist so a diverging rung
  cannot starve later rungs or turn failure into a minute-long timeout.
rules.rule: Keep ladder failures graceful by using per-rung heartbeat budgets so a diverging rung cannot starve later rungs or turn failure into a minute-long timeout.

rules.quote:
Differential parity reporting should distinguish "Lean pass via
  automation" from "Lean pass via user twin proof" rather than counting
  twin-discharged cases as failures
rules.rule: Differential parity reporting should distinguish "Lean pass via automation" from "Lean pass via user twin proof" rather than counting twin-discharged cases as failures.

rules.quote: Add new features/bugs as files in `docs/issues/`
rules.rule: Add each new feature or bug as a file in `docs/issues/`.

rules.quote: leave `github: null`
rules.rule: Leave `github: null` in the front matter of a newly added issue file.

rules.quote: run `scripts/sync_issues.py` to publish
rules.rule: Run `scripts/sync_issues.py` to publish newly added issue files to GitHub.

rules.quote: never recreate `docs/features.md` or `docs/wrinkles.md`
rules.rule: Never recreate `docs/features.md`.

rules.quote: never recreate `docs/features.md` or `docs/wrinkles.md`
rules.rule: Never recreate `docs/wrinkles.md`.

rules.quote: keep `docs/issues/README.md` and the README subsection in sync
rules.rule: When workflow-visible behaviour changes, keep `docs/issues/README.md` in sync.

rules.quote: keep `docs/issues/README.md` and the README subsection in sync
rules.rule: When workflow-visible behaviour changes, keep the "Issue tracker" subsection in `README.md` in sync.

rules.quote: extend `sync_issues.py` rather than adding a parallel script
rules.rule: Extend `scripts/sync_issues.py` rather than adding a parallel sync script.

rules.quote: Reports still live under `docs/`
rules.rule: Keep reports under `docs/`.

rules.quote: One file per issue
rules.rule: Keep one Markdown file per issue in `docs/issues/`.

rules.quote: open issues at the top level
rules.rule: Keep files for open issues at the top level of `docs/issues/`.

rules.quote: closed ones under `docs/issues/closed/`
rules.rule: Keep files for closed issues under `docs/issues/closed/`.

rules.quote: Filenames are a stable slug of the title
rules.rule: Name each issue file as a stable slug of its title.

rules.quote: the GitHub number lives in front matter, not the filename
rules.rule: Store the GitHub issue number in the front matter `github` field, not in the filename.

rules.quote: Avoid lookaheads on specific substrings.
rules.rule: When parsing IR or structured text on the Lean side, do not use lookahead on specific substrings; use a proper lexer and parser instead.

rules.quote: never substring lookahead
rules.rule: Never parse Lean-side IR or structured text with substring lookahead; use a real tokenizer and recursive-descent or Parsec parsing.

rules.quote:
Any new component that consumes IR or structured text on
the Lean side must use proper lexing/parsing.
rules.rule: Any new Lean-side component that consumes IR or structured text must use proper lexing and parsing.

rules.quote:
Keep the twin methodology
(generated/ vs proofs/) intact — Lean emits the generated files.
rules.rule: Keep the generated/ vs proofs/ twin methodology intact, with Lean emitting the generated files.

rules.quote:
Fragment
growth in any milestone must extend the IR grammar, `docs/ir.md`, the Rust
serializer, and the Lean parser in the same slice
rules.rule: When fragment growth occurs in any milestone, extend the IR grammar, docs/ir.md, the Rust serializer, and the Lean parser in the same slice.

rules.quote: update `docs/TUTORIAL.md` in the same commit
rules.rule: When workflow-visible behavior changes (scripts, macros, or example layout), update docs/TUTORIAL.md in the same commit.

rules.quote: its user-visible additions should extend the tutorial
rules.rule: When M2 lands, extend docs/TUTORIAL.md with its user-visible additions.

rules.quote: must be built as **Lean libraries and tactic integrations**
rules.rule: Build M4 (specialty arithmetic: bit vectors, nonlinear/ring arithmetic, compute-style proofs) as Lean libraries and tactic integrations.

rules.quote: lemma libraries over the Vermilion prelude models
rules.rule: Build M4 as lemma libraries over the Vermilion prelude models.

rules.quote: discharge rungs using Lean-native automation
rules.rule: Discharge M4 rungs using Lean-native automation (bv_decide, ring, polyrith, nlinarith, decide/norm_num, Mathlib).

rules.quote: mirror of Verus's SMT encodings
rules.rule: Do not build M4 as a mirror of Verus's SMT encodings.

rules.quote: no AIR-style bit-blasting bridges
rules.rule: Do not add AIR-style bit-blasting bridges to M4.

rules.quote: encoding-level fuel/trigger machinery
rules.rule: Do not add encoding-level fuel/trigger machinery to M4.

rules.quote: machine-int goals may move to `BitVec` views through
rules.rule: Machine-int goals may be moved to BitVec views through proved conversion lemmas.

rules.quote: close by `bv_decide`
rules.rule: After moving machine-int goals to BitVec views, close them by bv_decide.

rules.quote: nonlinear goals get a curated lemma set
rules.rule: Give nonlinear goals a curated lemma set.

rules.quote: `nlinarith`/`polyrith` rungs
rules.rule: For nonlinear goals, add nlinarith/polyrith rungs.

rules.quote: nothing enters the TCB
rules.rule: Do not add anything to the trusted computing base (TCB) through M4 libraries.

rules.quote: ordinary proved Lean code
rules.rule: Make M4 libraries ordinary proved Lean code.

rules.quote: proceed M3 → M4 without further
rules.rule: After finishing the remaining parts of M3, proceed to M4 without asking for further confirmation.

rules.quote: STOP at the end of M4
rules.rule: Stop at the end of M4.

rules.quote: start from library design
rules.rule: When M4 opens, start from library design.

rules.quote: ladder with library-backed rungs
rules.rule: Extend the vrml ladder with library-backed rungs.

rules.quote: keep verdict coherence measured
rules.rule: Keep verdict coherence measured differentially, as usual.

rules.quote:
Do not build `verus2vermilion` or introduce
Vermilion-only spec syntax.
rules.rule: Do not build a `verus2vermilion` annotation translator, and do not introduce Vermilion-only spec syntax.

rules.quote:
When a Verus construct is scripting-only,
ignore it (with a warning where useful) rather than requiring a rewrite.
rules.rule: When a Verus construct is scripting-only (SMT-era scripting with no Lean meaning), ignore it, with a warning where useful, rather than requiring the user to rewrite it.

rules.quote: triggers are **preserved** in the IR and documented in generated code
rules.rule: Preserve triggers in the IR and document them in generated code; do not drop them.

rules.quote: Nothing is rewritten in user sources.
rules.rule: Do not rewrite user source files to translate or modify Verus constructs.

rules.quote: **Per-function is the default**
rules.rule: Use per-function emission (one Lean file per verified function) as the default emission mode, unless the per-file mode is explicitly requested.

rules.quote: they never duplicate definitions
rules.rule: Never duplicate the datatype or spec-function definitions in each unit file; units must import the shared Specs module instead.

rules.quote: Keep Specs shared-and-imported
rules.rule: Keep the datatype and spec-function definitions in the shared Specs module and imported by the units.

rules.quote: never inline or duplicate definitions into units
rules.rule: Never inline or duplicate shared definitions into unit files.

rules.quote: The per-file mode must keep working behind `--per-file`, byte-identical to the pre-refactor output.
rules.rule: Keep the per-file emission mode working behind the `--per-file` flag, with output byte-identical to the pre-refactor output.

rules.quote: Results must be consistent across modes
rules.rule: Ensure obligations, statement hashes, diagnostics, and verdicts are identical across emission modes.

rules.quote: run it when touching emission
rules.rule: Run `scripts/test_emission_modes.sh` whenever changing emission code.

rules.quote: **No absolute paths** anywhere in emitted artifacts or tool plumbing
rules.rule: Never use absolute paths in emitted artifacts or tool plumbing; use repository-relative paths for manifests, imports, olean targets, and `--root` arguments.

rules.quote: New emission features must work in BOTH modes
rules.rule: Make every new emission feature work in both per-function and per-file modes.

rules.quote: keep the mode-invariance property
rules.rule: Preserve the mode-invariance property when changing emission.

rules.quote: extend the A/B harness when in doubt
rules.rule: When unsure whether a change preserves mode invariance, extend the A/B harness.

rules.quote:
Write any new report, ledger, or measurement summary to
`docs/reports/`
rules.rule: Write any new report, ledger, or measurement summary to the docs/reports/ directory.

rules.quote: never recreate a root-level `reports/` directory
rules.rule: Never recreate a root-level reports/ directory.

rules.quote: never inline spec-function bodies
rules.rule: Never inline spec-function bodies at lowering time when a spec function appears in a spec expression.

rules.quote: keep fuel out of the logic
rules.rule: Keep fuel out of the logic: do not add fuel constants to the IR or the Lean prelude.

rules.quote:
assert the callee's `requires`, bind a fresh
  result symbol, assume its `ensures`
rules.rule: For spec-function calls at proof/exec statement level, assert the callee's requires, bind a fresh result symbol, and assume the callee's ensures (Dafny-method style).

rules.quote: the IR grows function application
rules.rule: Extend the IR with function application so spec function calls in expressions are represented as applications.

rules.quote:
every user spec fn is emitted
  as a **real Lean definition** (`termination_by` from the Verus-checked
  decreases)
rules.rule: Emit every user spec function as a real Lean definition, using termination_by derived from the Verus-checked decreases clause.

rules.quote:
the machine prover
  receives **per-occurrence ground defining equations** as hypotheses
rules.rule: Provide the machine prover with per-occurrence ground defining equations as hypotheses for spec function applications.

rules.quote: never quantified definition axioms
rules.rule: Never emit quantified definition axioms for spec functions.

rules.quote:
machine attempts must reproduce Verus's visibility
  verdicts
rules.rule: Machine attempts must reproduce Verus's visibility verdicts so differential parity is preserved.

rules.quote: `hide`/`#[verifier::opaque]` suppresses the equations
rules.rule: When a spec function is hidden or marked #[verifier::opaque], suppress its defining equations for machine attempts.

rules.quote: `reveal` restores them
rules.rule: When a spec function is revealed, restore its defining equations for machine attempts.

rules.quote:
`reveal_with_fuel(f, n)` = n rounds of ground
  instantiation at lowering time
rules.rule: Lower reveal_with_fuel(f, n) as n rounds of ground instantiation of f's defining equations at lowering time.

rules.quote: Interactive twin proofs may still `unfold` anything
rules.rule: Interactive twin proofs may use unfold on any spec function.

rules.quote: the agent is responsible for keeping the VC-generation implementation and `docs/vcgen.md` in sync.
rules.rule: Keep the VC-generation implementation and docs/vcgen.md in sync.

rules.quote: update `docs/vcgen.md` in the **same slice**
rules.rule: When changing VC generation (processStmt/generateObligations, the generation state, the obligation shape, the unfold/visibility policy, or the emitted form in renderObligation), update docs/vcgen.md in the same slice.

rules.quote: re-read `docs/vcgen.md`
rules.rule: Before finishing any VC-generation change, re-read docs/vcgen.md.

rules.quote: confirm every rule still matches the code
rules.rule: Before finishing any VC-generation change, confirm that every rule in docs/vcgen.md still matches the code.

rules.quote: User-facing names are `vrml`
rules.rule: Name user-facing items with the `vrml` prefix: the tactic `vrml`, attributes `@[vrml]` and `@[vrml_obligation]`, and binaries `vrml_check` and `vrml_sync`.

rules.quote: namespaces keep the full `Vermilion` name
rules.rule: Keep the full `Vermilion` name for library namespaces.

rules.quote: Lean is the only verifier
rules.rule: In example pipelines, treat Lean as the only verifier.

rules.quote: `--no-verify` as a front end
rules.rule: Run Verus with `--no-verify` as a front end in example pipelines.

rules.quote: failures must be visibly Lean's
rules.rule: Make verification failures visibly attributed to Lean, using the `error[vermilion]` branding.

rules.quote: Verus's own SMT verdict is consulted only by
rules.rule: Consult Verus's own SMT verdict only in the differential harness.

rules.quote: `examples/<name>/run.sh` delegating to a
rules.rule: Give each example its own `examples/<name>/run.sh` that delegates to the shared `scripts/run_example.sh`.

rules.quote: never conflate demos into one script
rules.rule: Never combine multiple demos into one script.

rules.quote: every run emits `generated/`
rules.rule: Have every run emit a `generated/` directory containing machine statements and `vrml` proof attempts.

rules.quote: reconciles the user-editable `proofs/` twin via `vrml_sync`
rules.rule: Reconcile the user-editable `proofs/` twin via `vrml_sync` on every run.

rules.quote: when automation succeeds and nothing is edited;
rules.rule: When automation succeeds and nothing in `proofs/` is edited, make the `proofs/` file byte-identical to its generated counterpart.

rules.quote: `sorry` + warning where
rules.rule: Where automation fails, write `sorry` with a warning into the `proofs/` twin.

rules.quote: user proofs survive while their statement hash matches
rules.rule: Keep user proofs in `proofs/` while their statement hash matches.

rules.quote: and are replaced (with a warning) when stale
rules.rule: Replace stale user proofs in `proofs/` with a warning.

rules.quote: Lake builds only the twins.
rules.rule: Make Lake build only the `generated/` and `proofs/` twins.

rules.quote: Emphasize the generated-attempts vs user-proofs convention in each
rules.rule: In each example's README, emphasize the convention distinguishing generated attempts from user proofs.

rules.quote: No machine-specific paths
rules.rule: Do not put machine-specific paths in the repo.

rules.quote: `setup_verus.sh` auto-clones the pinned
rules.rule: Have `setup_verus.sh` auto-clone the pinned Verus into `~/.cache/vermilion/verus`.

rules.quote: never inside the repo
rules.rule: Never clone Verus inside the repo.

rules.quote: Suppress Lean unused-variable linter noise in generated modules.
rules.rule: Suppress the Lean unused-variable linter in generated modules.

rules.quote: The whole project must build with the single command `./scripts/build.sh`
rules.rule: Ensure the whole project builds with the single command `./scripts/build.sh`.

rules.quote: tutorial (docs/TUTORIAL.md) updated in the same commit as workflow changes.
rules.rule: Update `docs/TUTORIAL.md` in the same commit as any workflow change.

rules.quote: Preserve these invariants in M2 (loops, watch mode);
rules.rule: When working on M2 (loops, watch mode), preserve the repo's existing invariants.

rules.quote: extend `run_example.sh` and `vrml_sync` rather than adding new monolithic
rules.rule: Extend `run_example.sh` and `vrml_sync` rather than adding new monolithic scripts.

rules.quote: keep new user-typed commands short (`vrml*`).
rules.rule: Keep new user-typed commands short, with names starting with `vrml`.
